funnyQuote: I debug with console.log and I regret nothing.
tagline: I build web stuff that works, loads fast, and doesn't make people rage-quit. Frontend first, but happy to go full stack or backend.

about.heading: Pixel-perfect UI on code that stays clean.
about.bio1: I turn mockups into interfaces that match them pixel for pixel, built from components the next dev can read without a map.
about.bio2: Vue and Nuxt are home turf; React, Next.js, and TypeScript are the neighborhood. And I don't stop at the browser: I'm just as happy writing the SQL, the access rules, and the realtime sync behind it.
about.bio3: When I'm not coding, I'm probably drinking coffee and thinking about it anyway.

stack.heading: Tools I work with
stack.sub: The stuff I actually reach for when building things that need to work, scale, and not look like a template.

experience.heading: Where I've worked (so far)
experience.sub: Real products, real deadlines, and a growing list of lessons about what makes code last.

highlights: Built component libraries that helped the team ship faster
Integrated REST APIs and handled state across some genuinely gnarly multi-step flows
Turned designers' mockups into pixel-perfect UI in large Vue.js and Nuxt.js apps
Built responsive layouts and reusable components in React and JavaScript
Shipped UI features straight from design specs
Picked up team workflows (Git, code quality, Scrum) working alongside senior devs
Taught myself HTML, CSS, JavaScript, then Vue.js and React, through docs, personal projects, and plain stubbornness. No bootcamp.

projects.heading: Things I've built
projects.sub: Two live apps and the site you're on, each with its code.

entries.title: Angel Front Themes
entries.description: UI palette and theme generator built with Vue 3 + TypeScript: custom HEX↔RGB↔OKLCH color engine, color-harmony generation, light/dark theming, WCAG contrast validation, and CSS/Tailwind/SCSS/JSON export.

entries.title: Noob Draw
entries.description: Multiplayer Pictionary where Postgres is the server: RLS-secured SQL functions run every turn, score, and hint, live-synced over WebSockets.

entries.title: angeldlt.dev
entries.description: The page you're scrolling right now: Nuxt 4 and Vue 3 with TypeScript, bilingual from the ground up, and a terminal that types itself.
